records.issue_text: src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:481–482: When no local Integration exists, the Integration.DoesNotExist handler advances the pipeline without verifying authenticated-user ownership, allowing a supplied installation ID to proceed before its webhook creates the local record.
records.rationale: The finding identifies a real security issue. Looking at line 481 in the diff, when `Integration.DoesNotExist` is caught, the code calls `return pipeline.next_step()` without any ownership verification. At this point, the `github_authenticated_user` has been bound to pipeline state (from OAuthLoginView), but the ownership check (comparing `github_authenticated_user` to `integration.metadata['sender']['login']`) only happens AFTER the try/except block when the Integration DOES exist (lines 493-500).
